currentWindowsReleaseBuild.sourceState: Windows x64 Release shim built from source base b4cf0f6907ac823454a203b8f2e8372381b1e6f6 plus the current Native working-tree changes. It implements same-worker preview pause/resume: pause gates new submissions, drains in-flight work, then hides the existing session on its SDK owner thread; resume shows that session without recreating the window or transfer resources. Full close continues to drain and release resources after proof. No vendor optical-output validation is claimed.

traceOnlyBuild.purpose: Conditional session/window/device/texture lifecycle tracing and explicit per-frame texture diagnostics for the Start-Stop-Start investigation.

traceOnlyBuild.optionalSnapshotOutput: LKG_BRIDGE_SNAPSHOT_SESSION_SUFFIX=1 appends .session-<id> before the extension. LKG_BRIDGE_SNAPSHOT_FRAME_SEQUENCE=1 saves source and Bridge textures after successful draw at frames 1, 3, and 5 with per-session filenames and opt-in D3D11 staging readback pixel statistics. Unset preserves the existing single-snapshot behavior.
